#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <sstream>

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, b;
    std::cin >> n >> b;
    std::vector<int> numbers(n);
    std::vector<int> values(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> numbers[i];
        values[i] = (numbers[i] % 2 == 0) ? -1 : 1;
    }

    int totalSum = 0;
    std::vector<int> differences;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        totalSum += values[i];
        if (totalSum == 0) {
            int diff = std::abs(numbers[i + 1] - numbers[i]);
            differences.push_back(diff);
        }
    }

    std::sort(differences.begin(), differences.end());

    int accumulatedCost = 0;
    int maxCount = 0;
    for (int diff : differences) {
        if (accumulatedCost + diff <= b) {
            accumulatedCost += diff;
            ++maxCount;
        }
    }

    std::cout << maxCount << "\n";

    return 0;
}
